meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 它帮你设置或检查 claude-mem 云端同步:读取你在 cmem.ai → Connect 拿到的 token、user id、Hub URL,写入设置文件,重启 worker 并验证,再报告设备 id、待同步数量和错误。
howto.when: 当你提到「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」「cmem pro」等说法,或想把记忆库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账户、查看同步状态时接管。

say.text: 检查一下我的记忆同步状态
帮我设置 cloud sync,我有 cmem.ai 的连接信息
say.note: 会向你索取三个连接值并写入设置文件

say.text: 重启 worker,确认 SyncHub 连接是否通
say.note: 会调用重启接口并轮询验证状态

howto.what_en: Sets up or checks claude-mem cloud sync: reads the token, user id, and SyncHub URL from cmem.ai → Connect, writes them to ~/.claude-mem/settings.json, restarts the worker, verifies, and reports device id, pending counts, and errors.
howto.when_en: Use when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro" and similar, or want your claude-mem memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Queries the local worker sync status route

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync with my cmem.ai connection values
say_en.note: Asks for the three values and writes settings.json

say_en.text: Restart the worker and verify the SyncHub connection
say_en.note: Calls the restart route and polls status
